PROP-e5782b58-pre-014.text: Admin toggle-admin must not allow self-demotion that removes the last admin from the system.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-014.assertion: forall toggle_admin(admin, target): NOT (target == admin AND count(admins) == 1)

locations.note: Self-modification is blocked at lines 508-510: 'if (user.id === userId) return error'. However, there is NO check for last-admin scenario — if admin A toggles admin B off and B is the last admin, the system allows it. Only self-demotion is prevented.
